messages.de: Mein Bestreben ist unterdessen etwas wenig Gewisses hier zu haben — dann läßt es sich mit der Hülfe des Unsichern ganz gut hier leben — und dann — zu heirathen!
messages.en: My endeavors are directed at present to securing a small but certain income, which, together with what chance may put in my way, may enable me to live and — to marry!
messages.ko: 지금 제가 애쓰는 건 여기서 적더라도 확실한 수입을 얻는 거예요. 그러면 불확실한 수입의 도움을 받아 이곳에서 꽤 잘 살 수 있고, 그다음엔 — 결혼하는 거예요!

messages.de: Ein lediger Mensch lebt in meinen Augen nur halb …
messages.en: An unmarried man, in my opinion, enjoys only half a life.

messages.de: Doch nicht eine Weberische? — Ja eine Weberische! — aber nicht Josepha — nicht Sophie — sondern Constanze, die mittelste.
messages.en: Not one of the Webers, surely? Yes, one of the Webers, — not Josepha, not Sophie, but the third daughter, Constanze.

messages.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 180 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

messages.de: Sie ist nicht häßlich, aber auch nichts weniger als schön, — ihre ganze Schönheit besteht in zwei kleinen schwarzen Augen und in einem schönen Wachsthum.
messages.en: She is not plain, but at the same time far from being handsome; her whole beauty consists in a pair of bright black eyes and a pretty figure.
messages.ko: 못생기진 않았지만 미인이라고 하기도 어려워요. 그녀의 아름다움은 전부 작고 까만 두 눈과 고운 몸매에 있어요.

messages.de: … sie frisirt sich auch alle Tage selbst — versteht die Hauswirthschaft, hat das beste Herz von der Welt — ich liebe sie und sie liebt mich von Herzen
messages.en: She dresses her own hair, understands housekeeping, and has the best heart in the world. I love her with my whole soul, as she does me.
messages.ko: 머리도 날마다 혼자 손질하고, 살림도 잘 알고, 세상에서 가장 착한 마음씨를 가졌어요. 저는 그녀를 사랑하고 그녀도 진심으로 저를 사랑해요.

note.ko: 아버지가 지난 편지 끝의 말이 무슨 뜻이냐고 묻자, 모차르트는 이 편지에서 처음으로 결혼 계획을 털어놓아요. 상대는 그가 하숙했던 베버 집안의 셋째 딸 콘스탄체였어요. 그는 콘스탄체를 사랑하게 된 건 잘츠부르크 대주교 밑의 자리를 그만둔 뒤 그 집에 살면서부터였다고 써요.
note.en: His father had asked what the closing words of his last letter meant, and in this letter Mozart reveals for the first time that he wants to marry. The girl was Constanze, the third of the Weber daughters, in whose family's house he had lodged. He writes that his love began only after he had left his post, while he was living in their house.
note.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 180 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

replies.de: Das halbe Leben? Das war mir neu, und ich hatte sofort viele Fragen.
replies.en: Half a life? That's new to me; if you write again, I will ask many questions.
replies.ko: 반쪽 인생이라는 말은 처음 듣는데, 묻고 싶은 게 많아요.
replies.koLow: 반쪽 인생이라는 말은 처음 듣는데, 묻고 싶은 게 많아.

replies.de: Ich lächle beim Lesen, weil du so warm von Constanze schreibst.
replies.en: I was smiling while I was reading how warmly you write about Constanze.
replies.ko: 콘스탄체 이야기를 읽으면 볼프강 마음이 따뜻하게 느껴져요.
replies.koLow: 콘스탄체 이야기를 읽으면 네 마음이 따뜻하게 느껴져.

replies.de: Zuerst musst du ein sicheres Einkommen haben, dann kannst du an die Hochzeit denken.
replies.en: First find a small but certain income; then think about the wedding.
replies.ko: 볼프강 계획은 잘 읽었어요. 확실한 수입이 먼저고, 결혼은 그다음이에요.
replies.koLow: 네 계획은 잘 읽었어. 확실한 수입이 먼저고, 결혼은 그다음이야.
replies.koHigh: 계획은 잘 읽었습니다. 확실한 수입이 먼저이고, 결혼은 그다음입니다.

why.ko: 모차르트가 이 편지에서 처음 아버지께 소개한 콘스탄체를, 그녀의 형부 요제프 랑게가 결혼하던 해에 그렸어요.
why.en: The Constanze whom Mozart first describes to his father in this letter, painted in the year of their marriage by her brother-in-law Joseph Lange.

note.ko: ‘작고 까만 두 눈.’ 모차르트가 꼽은 그녀의 아름다움이에요.
note.en: ‘A pair of bright black eyes’: the beauty Mozart names first.

note.ko: ‘머리도 날마다 혼자 손질하고.’ 곱슬곱슬한 검은 머리예요.
note.en: ‘She dresses her own hair’: dark curls, done by herself.

note.ko: ‘고운 몸매.’ 소박한 하얀 옷차림이에요.
note.en: ‘A pretty figure’, in a plain white dress.

q.de: Welche Tochter der Webers liebt Wolfgang?
q.en: Which of the Weber daughters does Wolfgang love?
q.ko: 볼프강이 사랑하는 베버 집안 딸은 누구예요?

scene.en: A call with Wolfgang, who wants to get married · I'm his father Leopold

lines.de: Papa, ich muss dir etwas sagen. Ich habe mich verliebt.
lines.en: Papa, I have to tell you something. I've fallen in love.
lines.ko: 아빠, 드릴 말씀이 있어요. 사랑에 빠졌어요.

lines.de: Wirklich? In wen denn?
lines.en: Really? With whom?

lines.de: In Constanze Weber. Sie hat schöne schwarze Augen.
lines.en: Constanze Weber. She has beautiful black eyes.

lines.de: Hm. Und wovon wollt ihr leben?
lines.en: Hm. And what are you going to live on?

messages.en: Nothing more disagreeable than to be obliged to live in uncertainty, not knowing what is to happen.

messages.de: — Nun will ich Ihnen wegen dem wenigen Gewissen meine Meinung sagen. — Ich habe hier auf dreierlei mein Augenmerk.
messages.en: I must give you my opinion as to the probable sources I may look to for a small income. My eyes are directed to three things.
messages.ko: 이제 얼마 안 되는 확실한 수입에 대해 제 생각을 말씀드릴게요. 저는 여기서 세 가지를 눈여겨보고 있어요.

messages.de: Das zweite (welches aber bei mir das erste ist —) ist der Kaiser selbst. — Wer weiß — … doch ist den Hofschranzen niemals zu trauen.
messages.en: The second (the first, however, in my estimation) is the Emperor himself. Who knows? … but courtiers are never to be trusted.
messages.ko: 두 번째는 (제게는 사실 첫 번째지만) 황제 폐하 자신이에요. 누가 알겠어요… 하지만 궁정 사람들은 절대 믿을 수가 없어요.

messages.de: Das simple Versprechen getraute ich mir schon herauszulocken, — allein was hilft mir das für jetzt? — baares Geld ist besser.
messages.en: I could easily manage to extract a simple promise from him, but how would that benefit me at present? Ready money is better.
messages.ko: 그냥 약속 한마디쯤은 얼마든지 받아 낼 수 있어요. 하지만 지금 그게 무슨 소용이에요? 현금이 더 나아요.

messages.de: Liebster, bester Vater! — wenn ich von unserm lieben Gott schriftlich haben könnte, daß ich gesund bleibe und nicht krank sein werde, — o so wollte ich mein liebes treues Mädchen noch heute heirathen.
messages.en: My dear good father, if I knew for certain that a kind Providence would ordain that I should continue to enjoy good health, and exempt me from illness, oh! then I would marry my dear faithful Constanze this very day.
messages.ko: 사랑하는 아버지! 제가 건강하고 앓지 않으리라는 것을 하느님께 문서로 받아 둘 수만 있다면, 아, 그러면 제 사랑스럽고 진실한 아가씨와 오늘이라도 결혼할 거예요.
messages.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 186 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

speak.en: My dear good father, // if I knew for certain / that a kind Providence would ordain / that I should continue to enjoy good health, / and exempt me from illness, // oh! then I would marry / my dear faithful Constanze / this very day.
speak.ko: 사랑하는 아버지! // 제가 건강하고 / 앓지 않으리라는 것을 / 하느님께 문서로 받아 둘 수만 있다면, // 아, 그러면 / 제 사랑스럽고 진실한 아가씨와 / 오늘이라도 결혼할 거예요.

note.ko: 그림은 1870년에 헐린 케른트너토어 극장을 훗날 다시 그린 수채화예요. 모차르트는 콘스탄체와 결혼하기 위해 확실한 수입을 찾고 있었어요. 이 편지에서 그는 젊은 리히텐슈타인 후작의 관악 합주단, 황제, 그리고 막시밀리안 대공이라는 세 가지 가능성을 따져 봐요. 독일어 원문은 '내 사랑스럽고 진실한 아가씨'라고만 쓰고, 월리스의 영어 번역은 그 자리에 콘스탄체의 이름을 넣었어요.
note.en: The watercolour is a later view of the Kärntnertor Theatre, which was pulled down in 1870. Mozart was looking for a steady income so that he could marry Constanze. In this letter he weighs three prospects: a wind band for the young Prince Liechtenstein, the Emperor himself, and Archduke Maximilian. The German says only 'my dear faithful girl'; Wallace's English puts Constanze's name in its place.
note.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 186 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

replies.de: Deine drei Pläne waren klar, und ich hatte Hoffnung, dass einer davon gelingt.
replies.en: Your three plans are clear; if one of them works, you will have your income.
replies.ko: 세 가지 계획이 분명한데, 그중 하나는 꼭 잘될 거라고 믿어요.

en: if one of them will work

replies.de: Ein Versprechen allein hilft dir wenig; Bargeld ist besser, da stimme ich dir zu.
replies.en: Ready money is better, because a promise alone helps you very little.
replies.ko: 약속만으로는 별 도움이 안 될 거예요. 현금이 더 나아요.
replies.koLow: 약속만으로는 별 도움이 안 될 거야. 현금이 더 나아.
replies.koHigh: 약속만으로는 별 도움이 안 될 겁니다. 현금이 더 낫습니다.

replies.de: Wenn du gesund bleibst, ist alles andere leichter; das wünsche ich dir immer.
replies.en: Health matters most; I have always wished it for you, more than anything.
replies.ko: 건강이 가장 중요하기 때문에 늘 볼프강 건강을 빌어요.
replies.koLow: 건강이 가장 중요하기 때문에 늘 네 건강을 빌어.
replies.koHigh: 건강이 가장 중요하기 때문에 늘 건강을 빕니다.

why.ko: 모차르트가 찾던 ‘확실한 수입’은 황제와 궁정에서 나왔어요. 케른트너토어 극장은 그런 빈의 궁정 극장 가운데 하나였어요.

note.ko: 모차르트는 일요일마다 판 스비텐 남작의 집에서 헨델과 바흐의 푸가를 연주했어요. 그 푸가에 반한 콘스탄체가 졸라서 쓴 곡이 함께 보낸 전주곡과 3성 푸가(K. 394)예요. 같은 편지에 콘스탄체가 난네를에게 처음 쓴 짧은 편지도 들어 있었어요. 콘스탄체의 어머니와 언니들은 그 편지를 몰랐어요.
note.en: Every Sunday Mozart played Handel and Bach fugues at Baron van Swieten's house. Constanze fell in love with them and begged him to write one: the result was the prelude and three-part fugue (K. 394) he sent with this letter. Constanze's own first letter to Nannerl went in the same envelope, without her mother and sisters knowing.

note.ko: 그림은 1888년에 헐린 옛 부르크테아터를 훗날 그린 수채화예요. 『후궁으로부터의 도주』는 1782년 7월 16일 빈 부르크테아터에서 처음 올려졌어요. 첫 공연을 알린 모차르트의 편지는 남아 있지 않아서, 이 편지가 그가 직접 쓴 두 번째 공연 보고예요. 그는 이틀 공연으로 1200플로린이 들어왔다고 전하며 총보 원본을 아버지께 보냈어요.
note.en: The watercolour is a later view of the old Burgtheater, which was pulled down in 1888. Die Entführung aus dem Serail was first performed at the Burgtheater in Vienna on 16 July 1782. Mozart's letter about the premiere is lost, so this account of the second night is the first report in his own words that survives. He tells his father the two nights brought in 1,200 florins and sends him the original score.
note.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 195 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

messages.de: Meine Oper ist gestern allen Nannerln zu Ehren mit allem Applauso das drittemal gegeben worden, und das Theater war wieder, ungeachtet der schrecklichen Hitze, gestrotzt voll.
messages.en: My opera was given yesterday [St. Anne's Day] with all possible applause, in honour of all the Nannerls, for the third time; and, in spite of the frightful heat, the theatre was again crowded to suffocation.

messages.en: My dear kind father, I do implore you, by all you hold dear in the world, to give me your consent to my marrying my beloved Constanze.

note.ko: 아버지는 잘츠부르크 하프너 집안의 축하 행사를 위해 새 교향곡을 부탁했고, 모차르트는 이 편지와 함께 첫 알레그로를 보냈어요. 이 곡이 훗날 교향곡 35번 '하프너'(K. 385)가 되었어요. 7월 26일은 성 안나 축일, 곧 안나라는 이름을 가진 모든 '난네를'의 영명 축일이었어요.
note.en: His father had asked for a new symphony for a celebration in the Haffner family in Salzburg, and Mozart sent its first allegro with this letter; it became the 'Haffner' Symphony, K. 385. 26 July is St Anne's Day, the name day of every Anna, every 'Nannerl'.
note.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 196 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

messages.de: … da ich 2 Posttage umsonst auf eine Antwort wartete und die Copulation schon auf den Tag … festgesetzt war, ich Ihrer Einwilligung schon ganz versichert und getröstet, mich in Gottes Namen mit meiner geliebten Constanze trauen ließ.
messages.en: After waiting two posts in vain for your answer, the day of our wedding having been finally settled …, being quite assured of your consent, I was married, by the blessing of God, to my beloved Constanze.
messages.ko: 두 번의 우편일 동안 답장을 헛되이 기다렸고 결혼식 날짜는 이미 정해져 있었어요. 아버지가 허락하시리라 굳게 믿고 마음을 놓은 채, 하느님의 이름으로 사랑하는 콘스탄체와 결혼했어요.

messages.de: Unser ganzes Hochzeitfest bestund aus einem Souper, welches uns die Frau Baronin von Waldstädten gab, — welches in der That mehr fürstlich als baronisch war.

note.ko: 같은 시절 벨베데레에서 바라본 빈 그림으로, 결혼식을 그린 것은 아니에요. 모차르트와 콘스탄체는 1782년 8월 4일 빈에서 결혼했어요. 아버지의 허락 편지는 결혼식 다음 날에야 도착했어요. 증인으로는 콘스탄체의 어머니와 막내 여동생, 후견인 토르바르트, 그리고 잘츠부르크 출신 길로프스키가 함께했어요.
note.en: A painting of Vienna seen from the Belvedere in the same era, not a picture of the wedding. Mozart and Constanze were married in Vienna on 4 August 1782. His father's letters of consent arrived only the day after the wedding. Constanze's mother and youngest sister, her guardian von Thorwarth, and Gilofsky from Salzburg were among the few present.
note.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 199 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

piece.en: Mass in C minor, K. 427 – Kyrie

moments.commons: File:Mozart - Mass in C minor K.427 - I. Kyrie.mp3

why.ko: 모차르트와 콘스탄체는 성 슈테판 대성당에서 결혼했어요. 이 그림의 지평선에 그 첨탑이 솟아 있어요.
why.en: Mozart and Constanze were married in St Stephen's Cathedral; its spire rises on the skyline of this painting.

note.ko: 높은 첨탑의 성당에서 두 사람은 하느님의 이름으로 부부가 되었어요.
note.en: In the cathedral with the tall spire the two were married ‘by the blessing of God’.

note.ko: ‘아내도 저도 울기 시작했어요.’
note.en: ‘Both my wife and I shed tears.’

note.ko: 결혼 잔치는 저녁 식사 한 번이었지만, ‘제후가의 것 같았어요.’
note.en: The wedding feast was one supper, but ‘more princely than baronial’.

lines.de: Papa, ich wartete auf deine Antwort, dann heirateten wir.
lines.en: Papa, I waited for your answer, then we got married.

lines.de: Ohne meinen Brief? Na ja, er kam einen Tag später.
lines.en: Without my letter? Well, it came a day later.
lines.ko: 내 편지도 없이요? 뭐, 하루 늦게 도착했죠.

lines.de: Es tut mir leid. Wir möchten bald zu dir reisen.
lines.en: I'm sorry. We'd like to travel to see you soon.
lines.ko: 죄송해요. 곧 아빠를 뵈러 가고 싶어요.

lines.de: Schon gut. Ich gratuliere euch von Herzen.
lines.en: It's all right. Congratulations to you both, from my heart.

messages.de: Ich habe letzthin vergessen Ihnen zu schreiben, daß meine Frau und ich zusammen am Portiunculatage bei den Theatinern unsere Andacht verrichtet haben.
messages.en: I forgot, when I wrote to you lately, to say that on the feast of Portiuncula, my wife and I performed our devotions at the Theatines.
messages.ko: 지난번에 깜빡하고 못 썼는데요, 포르치운쿨라 축일에 아내와 저는 테아티노 성당에서 함께 기도를 드렸어요.

messages.de: … und ich habe gefunden, daß ich niemals so kräftig gebetet, so andächtig gebeichtet und communicirt hätte, als an ihrer Seite; — und so ging es ihr auch.
messages.en: and I found that I never prayed so fervently, nor confessed so piously, as by her side, and she felt the same.
messages.ko: 그리고 깨달았어요. 그녀 곁에서처럼 그렇게 간절히 기도하고 경건하게 고해한 적은 한 번도 없었다는 걸요. 그녀도 마찬가지였어요.

messages.de: Mit Einem Wort, wir sind für einander geschaffen, und Gott, der alles anordnet und folglich auch dieses alles also gefüget hat, wird uns nicht verlassen. Wir beide danken Ihnen auf das Gehorsamste für Ihren väterlichen Segen.
messages.en: In short, we are made for each other, and God, who orders all things, and consequently this also, will not forsake us. We both thank you truly for your fatherly blessing.
messages.ko: 한마디로 우리는 서로를 위해 태어났어요. 모든 것을 정하시고 이 일도 이렇게 이끌어 주신 하느님께서 우리를 버리지 않으실 거예요. 아버지의 축복에 우리 둘 다 진심으로 감사드려요.
messages.source: Mozarts Briefe (L. Nohl, 1865), Nr. 200 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/mozartsbriefehe00mozagoog

messages.de: Keinem Monarchen in der Welt diene ich lieber, als dem Kaiser, aber erbetteln will ich keinen Dienst.
messages.en: There is no monarch whom I would be more glad to serve than the Emperor, but I cannot humbly solicit an appointment.

messages.de: … und nun schon 3 Lectionen im Englischen genommen. — In 3 Monaten hoffe ich so ganz passable die engländischen Bücher lesen und verstehen zu können.
messages.en: and have now taken three lessons in English. I hope, in the course of three months, to be able to read and understand English books very tolerably.
messages.ko: 그리고 벌써 영어 수업을 세 번 받았어요. 석 달 뒤에는 영어 책을 꽤 괜찮게 읽고 이해할 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

note.ko: 결혼 열흘 남짓 뒤에 쓴 편지예요. 모차르트는 황제에게 자리를 구걸하지 않겠다며, 독일이 받아 주지 않으면 프랑스나 영국으로 가겠다고 말해요. 그래서 다음 부활절에 파리에 갈 생각으로 르 그로에게 편지를 썼고, 영어 수업도 받기 시작했어요.
note.en: Written less than two weeks after the wedding. Mozart says he will not beg the Emperor for a post, and that if Germany will not have him, France or England may. With an eye on Paris next Easter he had written to Le Gros, and he had begun English lessons.

text.en: Feast of Portiuncula · 2 August 1782, at the Theatines

why.ko: 이 편지에서 카우니츠 후작은 모차르트 같은 사람은 ‘백 년에 한 번 난다’고 말했다고 해요. 초상화는 그가 훨씬 젊었을 때 그린 거예요.
why.en: In this letter Prince Kaunitz is reported to have said that such people ‘only come into the world once in a hundred years’; the portrait shows him decades younger.

note.ko: 황제의 재상 카우니츠. 그도 황제가 천재를 아끼지 않는다며 불만이었대요.
note.en: Kaunitz, the Emperor's chancellor, who was himself displeased that the Emperor did not value genius more.

note.ko: 궁정의 높은 자리를 보여 주는 훈장. 모차르트는 자리를 구걸하지 않겠다고 해요.
note.en: An order of high court rank; Mozart will not beg for a post.

lines.de: Papa, danke für deinen Segen! Wir freuen uns sehr.

lines.de: Gern geschehen. Was gibt es Neues bei euch?
lines.en: You're welcome. What's new with you?

lines.de: Ich lerne Englisch. Ich hatte schon drei Stunden.
lines.en: I'm learning English. I've had three lessons already.
lines.ko: 영어를 배워요. 벌써 세 번 수업했어요.

lines.de: Toll! Bald liest du englische Bücher.
lines.en: Great! Soon you'll be reading English books.
